grep-i.text: Search for `warn` in server.log **without** caring about upper or lower case.
grep-i.hint: The `-i` option makes the search case-insensitive. You should get 3 matches.

sort.text: Show the fruits in `~/{{documents}}/{{fruits}}` in alphabetical order.

cut.text: Show only the subjects – field 2 – in `~/{{documents}}/{{grades}}` with `cut`.
cut.hint: The fields are separated by commas: `-d,` chooses the separator and `-f2` the field.
